java.lang.Object

Type Parameters:
E - the element type
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<MultisetAssert<E>, Multiset<E>>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<MultisetAssert<E>>, org.assertj.core.api.EnumerableAssert<MultisetAssert<E>, E>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<MultisetAssert<E>, Multiset<E>>, org.assertj.core.api.ObjectEnumerableAssert<MultisetAssert<E>, E>
public final class MultisetAssert<E> extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractCollectionAssert<MultisetAssert<E>, Multiset<E>, E, org.assertj.core.api.ObjectAssert<E>>
AssertJ assertions on a Multiset: the assertions on any collection, such as contains or hasSize, which counts occurrences, and assertions on the count of each element. 
assertThat(words).hasCount("foo", 2).hasDistinctSize(3).containsExactlyCounts(Map.of("foo", 2, "bar", 1, "baz", 1));
Since:
0.1.2
